verdict.rationale: Stagehand's core primitives take plain-English instructions: act() ('Write automation in plain English. No selectors'), extract() with an instruction, observe(), and an autonomous agent that turns high-level tasks into browser workflows. The MCP integration also lets users control browsers with commands like 'click the login button'. Community comments corroborate the self-healing, natural-language-driven approach. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably in practice (community evidence speaks mostly to self-healing and general usefulness), and evidence of natural-language operation outside SDK code and agent/MCP hosts.
